name: Junk removal & cleanouts — independent, B2B-referral-led (property managers, restoration, storage, realtors/estates), Chicago north/west side + near-west suburbs, with gated second/third service zones
summary: Job-based hauling service. Each 'customer' is one paid job (monthly churn = 100%; active = jobs in the month). Zone-1 demand (LSA/search + B2B accounts) ramps to a single-zone plateau calibrated to junk-only franchise unit revenues (1-800-GOT-JUNK years 1-3, Junk King median, College Hunks junk-only). A second (and in the optimistic case third) service zone is modelled as a 'zone expansion' staff line (is_sales_rep) that opens only after month 24 AND once monthly revenue reaches $42k (zone 1 near plateau); it adds jobs after a 9-month build. Crew labour and disposal are variable COGS; trucks are added by capacity (55 jobs/truck/month). Founder is owner-GM (operating profit is before owner compensation); an operations manager takes the founder off the truck and out of dispatch at $50k/month revenue. Replacing the founder with a salaried GM (~$95-110k/yr loaded) is NOT in operating profit and is discussed in the playbook.
evidence_notes: Ticket: Junk King CY2024 avg $399/job (median $389) [B, WS18-S001]; College Hunks CY2025 junk-only franchised median job size $443 [B, E-WS18003-S001]; 1-800-GOT-JUNK 2025 national load averages $107-396 small, $396-600 medium, $600-1,099 large; sofa $125, mattress $101 [B, E-WS18003-S004].

Lead economics: College Hunks CY2025 franchised median cost per lead $32 and lead-to-close 40%; junk-only units 4,726 leads -> 2,345 completed jobs median; its sales & loyalty centre generated 48% of junk gross sales [B, E-WS18003-S001].

Unit revenue by tenure (junk-only brand): 1-800-GOT-JUNK CY2023 US franchisees 0-12 months avg $220,855, 12-24 months avg $511,647, >72 months avg $3,599,006 / median $2,764,205 (median 17 subterritories) [B, E-WS18003-S003]; CY2024 >72 months median $2,032,678, per-subterritory median $130,727 [D, E-WS18003-S005]. Junk King CY2024 avg $554k, median $436k [B, WS18-S001].

Scale economics: College Hunks CY2025 franchised 60+ months (avg 3 territories) median sales $1,555,903, EBITDA median $137,005 (8.8%) after ~12% fees and before truck payments/owner pay; insurance median $112,206, office labour $108,661, marketing $165,909; corporate 60+ months (avg 8 territories, GM-run) median sales $5,037,584, EBITDA median $211,776 [B, E-WS18003-S002].

Correction vs Stage D: College Hunks medians include moving revenue (138 of 144 franchised stores are junk & move), so the Stage D single-zone plateau (~$690k by month 24) was calibrated above junk-only benchmarks; zone-1 plateau lowered to ~$540k and ramp lengthened to 30 months (base).

Chicago disposal: SWANCC Glenview $100/ton ($25 min), white goods $25/item, mattresses $75/item from 1 Mar 2026 [B, DF-S016]; private transfer-station gate rates MISSING. Electronics: illegal to landfill covered devices in Illinois (Consumer Electronics Recycling Act) [A, E-WS18003-S009]; refrigerant appliances: final disposer must verify recovery (EPA s.608) [A, E-WS18003-S010].

Labour: Chicago MSA hand laborers median $40,550, light-truck drivers $47,950 [C, DF-S020]; first-line supervisors of laborers/material movers median $68,330 [C, E-WS18003-S011]; general & operations managers median $109,390 [C, E-WS18003-S012].

Trucks: Penske Used Trucks listings Nov-2026: 2021-22 Isuzu NPR/NPRXD box trucks $27,500-$52,000 asking (e.g., 2022 NPRXD 129k mi $44,500); Ford E350 cutaways $27,250-$37,250 [B asking, E-WS18003-S007]. U-Haul rentals are DIY-moving only and junk-removal firms are ineligible for U-Haul business accounts [B, E-WS18003-S006, E-WS18003-S015] - pilot must use a commercial rental or subcontracted truck.

Insurance: Insureon debris-removal median premiums GL $138/mo, WC $175/mo, commercial auto $268/mo, umbrella $93/mo (small applicants, D floor) [E-WS18003-S008]; College Hunks insurance ~7% of sales at every tenure [B, E-WS18003-S002].

Licensing: Chicago Private Scavenger Vehicle licences are per vehicle; 1-800-GOT-JUNK? Chicagoland is the only junk-removal brand holding them (10); Junk Peddler licences run 2 years (29 unexpired, new issues 1-7/yr since 2020) [A, DF-S015, E-WS18003-S013]; fees MISSING (chicago.gov and amlegal blocked).
Churn-based stress tests and the churn tornado bar are not meaningful here (churn is structurally 100% in a job-based model); read CAC, ticket, margin, labour and demand tests.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Entity, insurance binder, used truck purchase, Chicago licence application (category documented [A, DF-S015]; processing time and fee MISSING). Validation pilot runs before this clock starts.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Consumers book same day to one week; B2B accounts order after a trial job (Stage C memo).
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Months for zone-1 demand to reach plateau. 1-800-GOT-JUNK US franchisees average $220,855 in months 0-12 and $511,647 in months 12-24 WITH national brand and call centre (CY2023) [B, E-WS18003-S003]; an independent is assumed slower (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Zone-1 inbound leads/month at plateau, back-solved to junk-only revenue benchmarks: cons ~58 jobs x $390 = ~$270k/yr (Junk King bottom half); base ~106 x $430 = ~$545k/yr (between Junk King median $436k and 1-800-GOT-JUNK 12-24 month average $512k); opt ~170 x $470 = ~$960k (College Hunks junk-only median $849k-Junk King top quartile $1.12M) [B, WS18-S001, E-WS18003-S001, E-WS18003-S003]. College Hunks junk-only median 4,726 leads/yr (394/mo) across 3 territories [B, E-WS18003-S001].
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Lead -> photo/on-site quote. Combined with win rate gives lead-to-job 33% / 41% / 47% vs College Hunks median lead-to-close 40% (range 22-82%) [B, E-WS18003-S001].
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Quote -> booked paid job; calibrated so lead-to-job brackets College Hunks median lead-to-close 40% [B, E-WS18003-S001].
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Jobs/month added by each productive expansion zone (~45-60% of a zone-1 plateau: shared brand/reviews, B2B accounts that span zones). Benchmarks: College Hunks franchised medians rise from $691k (1 territory) to $869k (2) and $1.56M (3) [B, E-WS18003-S002, includes moving and tenure]; 1-800-GOT-JUNK mature per-subterritory median $130,727 [D, E-WS18003-S005].
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Repeat B2B jobs (property-manager turnovers, storage defaults, restoration contents) generated per 100 jobs in the prior month.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Junk King CY2024 avg $399/job (median $389) [B, WS18-S001]; College Hunks junk-only median job $443 (CY2025) [B, E-WS18003-S001]; B2B full-load mix lifts the base slightly (E).
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: After crew labour and disposal only. Junk King labour 20.6% + dumping 7.2% (=72% GM before fees) [B, WS18-S001]. Chicago: base labour 25% (laborer median $40,550 [C, DF-S020], loaded) + disposal 11% at $100/ton + item fees net of ~20-30% donation/scrap diversion [B, DF-S016]; cons 28% + 15%; opt 23% + 9% (E uplift on B base). Correction: Stage D base 65% understated labour vs its own job examples (2 crew x 2.5 h x $24 = 28.6% of a $420 job).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: College Hunks CY2025 median cost per lead $32 / 40% close = ~$80 per paid-lead job (12% of a $676 job) - and that is ON TOP of a national brand and a call centre that books 48% of junk sales [B, E-WS18003-S001]. Base blends ~70% paid-lead jobs at ~$80 with ~30% B2B/repeat jobs at ~$25 account-servicing cost (E). Stage D used $55; corrected upward.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website/GBP, truck-wrap amortisation, BOMA/IREM/CAI and realtor-board dues/events, donation-partner materials.
drivers.dso_days__source: Consumers pay at completion; property managers/restoration on net-30 (~20% of revenue in base).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Transfer-station fees paid at the scale [B, DF-S016]; crews paid bi-weekly (ignored).
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Smallest round amount keeping the base-case cash balance >= 0 (Stage E standardisation) - see playbook section 7. This is NOT spent up front: ~$2-3k validation, then ~$55k at truck purchase, the rest is ramp losses + second/third truck.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Truck replacement: 3-6 used box trucks x ~$45k every ~7 years = ~$20-38k/yr vs operating profit; heavier share when profit is thin (conservative). Truck prices per Penske used listings [B asking, E-WS18003-S007].
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Naperville junk/cleanout firm asks $285k on $220k seller-claimed cash flow (1.3x) [D, DF-S018]; BizBuySell waste-management & recycling sold comps 2021-25 median earnings multiple 3.14 (quartiles 2.14-3.88) on median $176,635 owner earnings - category includes route-based haulers that deserve more than junk removal [D, E-WS18003-S014]. Operating profit here is before owner pay (~SDE).
drivers.rep_ramp_months__source: Here = months from opening a new service zone (yard/parking, local LSA profile, B2B accounts) until it produces its steady job flow. No direct evidence; College Hunks franchise ramp shows month-12 sales ~1.5x month-1 [B, E-WS18003-S001].
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Price index growth; disposal fees in the region face upward pressure (Region-2 landfill life 12.4 yrs [A, DF-S017]).
drivers.tax_rate_pct__source: Standardised for cross-finalist comparison (Stage E protocol).
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: 1-800-GOT-JUNK system-wide revenue growth: 2020 +8.0%, 2021 +24.4%, 2022 +9.2%, 2023 -0.6% [B, E-WS18003-S003] - mature metro junk removal grows roughly with price + housing turnover; base 4% after zone build-out (E).
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Growth fades as zones saturate; no further zones modelled after year 5.
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Pre-tax return on growth capital (truck ~$42k + zone launch losses) at ~12-15% incremental operating margin on ~$250k revenue per truck-zone (cost structure per College Hunks 60+ months [B, E-WS18003-S002]).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Truck-downtime and winter-seasonality buffer (Chicago winter slower, E).

staff.role: Additional truck unit (fixed costs: commercial auto, maintenance, plates/licence, GPS)
staff.notes: Not a person: capacity trigger for trucks (first extra truck at 60 jobs/month, then one per 55 jobs = ~2.5-2.7 jobs/truck/day). Fixed cost = box-truck commercial auto ~$750/mo (E; Insureon debris-removal median $268/mo is a floor [D, E-WS18003-S008]) + maintenance ~$550/mo (E; College Hunks truck R&M ~2-3% of sales [B]) + plates/licence/GPS. Capex = used 16 ft box truck ~$37-45k + kit (Penske/dealer asking prices [B, E-WS18003-S007]). Crew wages are variable COGS.

Answers phones/LSA messages, books, routes, invoices B2B accounts. Chicago dispatcher median $58,900; CSR $47,100 [C, DF-S033]; loaded x1.2 (E). Hired at ~$420k/yr revenue run-rate (before that: founder + AI answering/booking) (College Hunks franchises spend ~6-7% of sales on office labour [B, E-WS18003-S002]).

staff.role: Operations manager (field supervisor; takes founder off the truck and out of dispatch)
staff.notes: Chicago first-line supervisors of laborers/material movers median $68,330 [C, E-WS18003-S011] x1.15 loaded. Hired at ~$600k/yr run-rate. Founder remains owner-GM (sales, accounts, finance); a full GM replacement (~$95-110k loaded; general & operations managers median $109,390 [C, E-WS18003-S012]) is NOT modelled.

staff.role: Admin & accounts at scale (bookkeeper/AR, B2B account coordinator, claims)
staff.notes: Hired above ~$1.08M/yr run-rate. College Hunks 60+ month stores spend ~8% of sales on office labour and carry 7-12% of sales in other unitemised costs [B, E-WS18003-S002]; this line keeps the multi-zone case from understating overhead (E).

staff.role: Service-zone expansion (satellite parking, zone LSA/GBP profile and B2B launch budget, zone crew-lead premium)
staff.notes: Opens zone 2 only after month 24 and once monthly revenue >= $42k (zone 1 near plateau); zone 3 at >= $82k/month (optimistic only). Each productive zone adds rep_new_customers_per_month jobs after rep_ramp_months (9). Cost (E): satellite parking ~$1,000, zone marketing minimums ~$1,000, crew-lead premium/supervision travel ~$1,500. Trucks for the extra jobs come from the capacity trigger.

overhead.item: Truck #1 fixed costs (commercial auto, maintenance, plates/licence, GPS)
overhead.notes: Insureon debris-removal commercial auto median $268/mo is a floor [D, E-WS18003-S008]; box truck driven by hired crew in Cook County ~$600-900/mo (E) + maintenance on a ~100k-mile truck (E).

overhead.item: GL + umbrella + workers' comp minimum premium + inland marine
overhead.notes: Insureon debris-removal medians GL $138 + WC $175 + umbrella $93 + inland marine $42 = ~$450/mo for small applicants [D, E-WS18003-S008]; base is ~2.4x that for a crewed operator (E). WC on crew payroll is inside the labour %. College Hunks insurance median ~7% of sales at every tenure [B, E-WS18003-S002] - total insurance in this model is ~6-8% of revenue at plateau.
College Hunks franchise rent & utilities median $33,371/yr at 13-36 months [B, E-WS18003-S002]; independent starts smaller (E).

overhead.item: Booking/FSM software + AI photo-quote and call/text answering
overhead.notes: Housecall Pro Essentials $149-189/mo [B, DF-S035] + AI receptionist/quote-draft tools ~$100-160/mo (E). AI x3 stress = +$700/mo.
Junk Peddler licence reportedly $150 per 2-year term [D, E-WS18003-S018; city fact sheet via search snippet, not fetched]; Private Scavenger per-vehicle fee MISSING (E).

capex.item: Used 16 ft box truck (2020-22 Isuzu NPR class) + wrap, ramps, dollies, straps, tools, PPE
capex.notes: Penske Used Trucks asking prices Nov-2026: 2021-22 NPR/NPRXD $27.5-52k; E350 cutaway $27-37k [B asking, E-WS18003-S007]; dealer 2021 NPR 16 ft ~$36-38k asking [D, E-WS18003-S020]. +$4-6k kit/wrap (E). Optimistic = E350 cutaway or pickup + 14 ft dump trailer.

transactions.name: Half-truck household cleanout (consumer, paid lead; Chicago bungalow basement)

lines.item: 2-person crew 2.5 h incl. drive & tip at ~$24/h loaded each
Disposal ~0.5 t at $100/t + 1 mattress $75 (mattress surcharge billed separately in practice)

transactions.notes: Disposal at SWANCC published rates [B, DF-S016]; ticket per Junk King avg / College Hunks junk median [B]; CPL and close rate per College Hunks CY2025 [B, E-WS18003-S001]. Contribution ~$75 (17%). Paid at completion.

transactions.name: Apartment turnover / eviction cleanout for a property manager (full truck, repeat account)

lines.item: Account servicing (no paid lead; share of field-sales time)

transactions.notes: Full-truck price $850 sits inside 1-800-GOT-JUNK's published 2025 large-load range $600-1,099 [B, E-WS18003-S004]; net-30 invoice. Contribution ~$425 (50%) - why repeat B2B accounts carry the business.

transactions.name: Single-item pickup (sofa), paid lead
transactions.notes: 1-800-GOT-JUNK 2025 average sofa price $125 (most pay $75-188) [B, E-WS18003-S004]. Contribution about -$28: paid-lead single items LOSE money unless batched on a route or set at a $150+ minimum.

transactions.name: Estate cleanout via realtor/senior-move-manager referral (whole house, 2 truckloads, 2 days)

lines.item: Referral thank-you / partner cost (no cash referral fee to licensed agents assumed)

transactions.notes: Price assumed at ~2.2 full loads x 1-800-GOT-JUNK large-load range [B anchor, E price]. Donation/resale diversion can cut disposal 20-40% (E). Contribution ~$525 (22%); labour-heavy. Adjacency to WS18-030 (estate sale/senior move).
